Role-play Benchmark
	

A comprehensive benchmark for evaluating Role-play Agents in Chinese and English scenarios.

	
		
		Dataset Summary
	

Role-play Benchmark is designed to evaluate Role-play Agents' ability to deliver immersive role-play experiences through Situated Reenactment. Unlike traditional benchmarks with verifiable answers, Role-play is fundamentally non-verifiable, e.g., there's no single "correct" response when a tsundere character is asked "Do you like me?".
